description: Scans the text of a health clinic's ad, post or landing page (up to 4,000 characters) for phrases that Meta and Google ad policies and the health-advertising rules of Spain, the UK, the US and Australia restrict: testimonials and reviews, promises of a cure, a guarantee or a result, superlatives, questions or statements about the reader's condition (Meta), before-and-after, deadlines and fear, and titles such as Dr. Each finding quotes the phrase with its rule, source link, certainty, severity and a safer pattern, and the result lists what a phrase scan cannot judge (images, the landing page, evidence, registration, offer terms). It is a first pass, not a review: it never says whether an ad can be published. Leave out patient names.

country.description: The clinic's country, for its health-advertising law: es Spain (with the EU rules), uk, us or au. Without it only the platform rules are scanned.

language.description: Language of the answer: es or en. The scan reads both languages either way.

platform.description: Where the ad runs. Without it both platforms' rules are scanned.

text.description: The ad text, post or landing page copy to scan (up to 4,000 characters). Leave out patient names.

name: scan_health_ad_copy

checked_patterns.description: How many of the phrase patterns had a rule in scope

country.description: The country whose rules were scanned; null: only the platforms' rules

counts.description: Flagged phrases by severity, those not listed included

findings.description: Most serious first, then in the order of the text; at most 40

certainty.description: medium only when every rule is medium

excerpt.description: The flagged phrase in its context, at most 120 characters, with patient names replaced

label.description: The category, in the language of the answer

certainty.description: How certain the rule is, as the health_ad_compliance playbook marks it

cite.description: The cited source, as the health_ad_compliance playbook (clinic-ad-compliance-review) gives it

code.description: The rule's code in the health_ad_compliance playbook (clinic-ad-compliance-review)

condition.description: When the rule applies only to some clinics (a US state, a profession); otherwise null

scope.description: The platform or the country the rule belongs to

severity.description: The severity in the health_ad_compliance playbook (clinic-ad-compliance-review): blocks_publishing, risk or improvement

safer_pattern.description: The safer pattern of the health_ad_compliance playbook for this kind of phrase

severity.description: The most serious severity of its rules

platform.description: The platform whose rules were scanned; null: Meta's and Google's

title: Scan health ad copy for risky phrases
